note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MON 8; A06b MON 8; L05 MON 24(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Montenegro, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Montenegro for 10 years uninterrupted immediately before the application. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country. Provision does not apply when a dual citizenship agreement exists with that country.
